messages.author: 891813bfbff9f848
messages.subject: How to fix regression in facet_grid( space = free ).
parts:
I have noticed a regression of functionality in facet_grid( space =
free ).
https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/issues/312

I post it here, because maybe someone could give me some pointers on
where to start to try and fix this.
I have done a little bit of digging and up to the function
layout_matrix in utilities-table-template.r everything seems fine. (at
least the widths and heights seem fine)
And the y-axis scale fine, only the x-axis do not scale...

Kind regards,

Willem

PS: Also please tell me if this is not appreciated, but my reasoning
was that this post is more about asking for pointers on how to fix it,
as to just raising awareness.

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: How to fix regression in facet_grid( space = free ).
parts:
Fixed in https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/commit/faded39f7e4582c3a062eb1a85765e75c55aff25.
The problem was in how the components of the plot were getting
combined - the width of the strips overrode the panel widths and
caused problems.

I discovered this by using gtable_show_layout on each of the gtable
objects until I discovered the point at which the correct sizing was
lost, and then noticed I'd made similar fix for axes.

Thanks for the bug report!

Hadley
